test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that contains a grammatical error in the underlined portion.**

There are three cupholders placed on the cupboards of the secretariat table.

options.text: __There are three cupholders__ placed on the cupboards of the secretariat table.
There are three cupholders placed __on the cupboards__ of the secretariat table.
There are three cupholders placed on the cupboards of __the secretariat table__
There are three __cupholders placed __on the cupboards of the secretariat table.

solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **There are three cupholders placed __on the cupboards__ of the secretariat table.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error here lies in the use of p
